result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends on how many employees you have, whether you need to manage pensions, and how much of the payroll process you want automated.

**If you're running a small business in the UK, I'd prioritise software that handles PAYE, HMRC submissions, pension auto-enrolment, payslips and year-end reporting.**

I wouldn't automatically choose the cheapest option: reliable HMRC submissions and good support are worth paying a little extra for.

## My top 5 UK payroll software recommendations

![MCA Computer Systems | Sage Platinum Business Partner South Africa](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/4pwtTjaCEGy_ZI_5v17TNhX8ZUMWvLSZOG941YYzgJpIV9h6QLC2bg-Mpg_WkWldsisHrfo5Er_UTKUiRZQOfb_RCHeIEhVuzygFhAYFxB-9aOhp3YIvo3TZoQyhZOtfGfCH7N8YeASbskujkIci1rX6_vUd8q7ailL6YAqa7S18SEPzKy-rZ9jT0hOXUAWb?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Sage Payroll**

(Best overall for small businesses)

- From approximately £12/month for 5 employees.
- PAYE, HMRC submissions and pension auto-enrolment.
- Good for businesses wanting straightforward payroll.
  
  [Sage website](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

---

![BrightPay Standard + Connect to BrightPay Cloud FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/w4enxIyDycO7AUK2q9MSigbCrvpztFs7Z_H6w-w2lUCrViF19Xl4mmIDmq49uY9OqMEZyacb1cfZ96kB1itVQG4Um52YB5FfIcdxh61NUZmjo-ZiQQw-o3a64YCd83vlmMVrUh7TPEkE6dshtPXZgYIC-gPHTX5mwqy58KHGJgCW85IZxwm6G0figtCehl5s?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BrightPay**

(Best dedicated payroll solution)

- Comprehensive UK payroll functionality.
- Pension integrations and statutory payments.
- Particularly good if you have an accountant handling payroll.
  
  [BrightPay website](https://www.brightpay.co.uk/)

---

![Free High-Quality xero logo png for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9qnwxOObu7ODCnjvtZS3OrO0aEo-O6ZxoDMA_BgXWHmpclDvIBWhiiFc7sv2CSwP8u7lVkQexj-2Q6JwX6bLCkmQGBaOEFUaRc4WBhsOFHNZO-ImlbOxfjscA06CBlmqvsyW9qGAz0ywS1dS_FiB_uxDnV6_EbbsbiPoLuJHAA6MH09EB8jLexW7FAqo1iFu?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Xero Payroll**

(Best for accounting integration)

- Payroll integrated with bookkeeping.
- Employee payslips and HMRC reporting.
- Ideal if you already use Xero.
  
  [Xero website](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![QuickBooks Payroll Workshop Coming up at Landmark - Landmark CPAs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EpjoKgv3qp1QFtZSwa4jOSAGoy_bpW7Sg9OVIiK8-oa8UMuOdZRCQiQ9wIV6A0EP90E_oKZqlgba5b3V-cBIKwbDpfEpoiDXWBpJxyQbp0PrvFWqMD5tYDybAbqob6mWzYEtZyXdxwg9oLN481huockY4Xh7GxIqIqUTHjoFCNUvsU8P9qXqQ0Z3Uur0cFsF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. QuickBooks Payroll**

- Good integration with business accounting.
- Automated payroll calculations and submissions.
- Good for existing QuickBooks customers.
  
  [QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

---

![Moneysoft Payroll Manager User Reviews & Pricing For 2026 - BusinessFinancing.co.uk](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/7ksdOV7E-FuiXPxwB-8w5JZkSHtBcjkVxCJYbFrODk4PmznMHOmA4B-tBaxnYCFYD6Jp0kSAbnQXIsecvAn3rHv3L9eIJmTsQHps-CqLdeVCxq8PEavEP85m-O6tbVJZIUw1amDOLcBgiDPKuXotb0Z1X2mhBds1tgi1vwa-scPjVzxF5ozKfmnh-hP00M1w?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Moneysoft Payroll Manager**

- Budget-friendly option.
- Around £95 + VAT annually.
- Particularly suitable for smaller businesses comfortable using desktop software.

- **Sage** if you want straightforward standalone payroll.
- **BrightPay** if payroll functionality is your main priority.
